{{Quote|Civilians, what a distasteful word. Bring me some of this rabble holed up in their homes and I'll give you a proper fighting force. We'll show these Tusken savages what war is about.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Berok Skoff]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TA" />}}
The '''Mos Espa Militia''' was a [[Militia/Legends|militia]] organization that protected the city of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TA" /> Yielding combatants similar to that of the [[Tatooine militia]],<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> it consisted of citizens ready to defend their city.<ref name="SWGTCG:MEM">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Mos Espa Militia}}</ref> The militia was rather understaffed and poorly equipped.<ref name="SWGTCG:CA" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Mos Espa Militia was commanded by [[Kav Goldor]]<ref name="SWG:TR" /> and trained by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Berok Skoff]].<ref name="SWG:TA" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Mos Espa Militia was pivotal during the defense of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], when [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] led by the [[Tusken King]] launched an [[Tusken Raider Invasion of Mos Espa|invasion]] of the [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="SWG:TA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mos Espa Militia appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Mos Espa Militia was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Tusken Army|Tusken Army]] heroic instance,<ref name="SWG:TA" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|Chapter 7]]" update on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
